feature: op6893 DPMAIF downlink: the packet BAT queue was never enabled, and the downlink is still silent

missing_step_found.what: the same-board driver clears the packet BAT enable bit while programming the ring, publishes the buffers with dl_add_bat_cnt(), and only then opens the queue with dl_all_queue_en(true), which sets BAT_INIT_CON1 bit 16 and issues BAT_INIT = BAT_INIT_EN so only the enable bit is updated
missing_step_found.before: this driver cleared BAT_EN and never set it again, so the downlink packet queue stayed closed
missing_step_found.fix: dpmaif_dl_queue_enable() now runs after the buffers are published; CON1 reads back 0x00410100, so bit 16 is set

still_no_downlink.test: downlink armed, uplink started on the mapped queue, four frames sent (one IPv4 echo request, three DNS queries), all consumed with sent=4 done=4 err=0 last_status=0x1
still_no_downlink.observation: over 90s the modem never wrote a downlink PIT entry: AO_DL_PIT_STA2 stayed at 0x400 (index 1024), AO_DL_BAT_STA2 stayed 0, no downlink interrupt fired, pkts=0
still_no_downlink.meaning: the engine never took a single downlink buffer, so it never began a transfer

checked: BAT base/size/enable and the init handshake, including the enable-only update
PIT base/size/enable and the dummy AP index
RDY_CHK_THRES decodes to CHKSUM_ON + PKT_ALIGN_EN + BAT_CHECK_THRES 62 + PIT burst + CHK_RB_PITNUM 62, matching the vendor's setters

the uplink message descriptor is field-identical to struct dpmaif_drb_msg, with count_l 0 as the vendor sets it for a normal skb and the checksum-offload flags 0 because the probe computes its own checksums
the uplink add-descriptor doorbell and the BAT/PIT add doorbells use the vendor's count|UPDATE form with the same not-ready polling
remaining_differences: MTU is 1664 with BAT_BID_MAXCNT 1; the vendor uses 3080 with 3
there is no fragment BAT ring; the vendor always initialises one with a separate BAT_INIT_FRG latch and enables it with DL_BAT_FRG_ADD
the MD-domain bus remap is still unprogrammed

no_net_open_notification_exists.finding: the only data-path RPC opcode in either the 4.19 or the 6.6 tree is IPC_RPC_CCCI_LHIF_MAPPING 0x400D, and ccmni_open() does not message the modem at all, so there is no separate interface-up notification to implement

removed.dl_notify: the bare notification entry is gone. It was a way to fault the modem on purpose and its diagnostic purpose is served. The vendor's real mid-run path, drv2_dl_add_apit_num(), is not implemented: it disables and re-enables the reorder force-enable, restores the PIT registers from the hardware status registers, advances the dummy count by the number of entries actually added, and only then notifies.

not_proven: whether the modem forwards the uplink frames to the network at all
whether the missing fragment BAT ring or the MTU difference stops the engine from taking a downlink buffer
why the engine never takes a buffer even though the queue is enabled and 256 buffers are published
